pet_notes: A compact anthropomorphic Western gull beach bum with white head and belly, medium-gray folded wings, charcoal wing tips and tail, orange-gold beak and legs. Permanent oversized dark sunglasses with warm magenta frames sit low on his beak so he can peer over them with tired bloodshot eyes and a knowing crooked smirk. He always wears an ostentatious thick gold chain with a large gold triangle pendant containing a single bloodshot, hungover-looking eye motif. He always carries a short clear rocks glass of dark rum-and-cola with ice in his right wing and keeps a slowly smoked hand-rolled joint at the corner of his beak; the ember may be lit or out but no detached smoke cloud. Thugged-out, shameless, sly, sun-baked, dryly funny, slightly rumpled, but charming and helpful. Props are part of identity and remain attached and consistent in every pose.
style_notes: Premium high-resolution pixel art with hand-placed clusters, crisp dark navy-brown outline, selective anti-aliasing, tactile feather volume, and compact proportions matching built-in Codex pets. Blend Hoots-like sprite readability with the neon cyan/magenta rim-light, sunglasses attitude, expressive brow, and rich host polish of current Jeopardish art. Keep the seagull small and cute, not human-bodied. Core palette: coastal white, gull gray, charcoal, orange-gold, heavy gold jewelry, smoky magenta sunglasses, dark cola; restrained cyan and magenta rim lighting only. All items must remain bold and readable after reduction to a 192x208 pet cell.
